name: Smallest AI Pulse
blurb: Low-latency multilingual STT — Pulse handles streaming and batch transcription with sub-100ms first-token claims.
about: Smallest AI Pulse is a proprietary speech-to-text model for real-time and pre-recorded transcription. The current documentation lists 35+ documented languages across streaming and batch modes, with speaker identification, timestamps, redaction, punctuation, keyword boosting and endpointing. Pulse Pro is a separate English-only batch model with a 5.42% average WER claim on the public Open ASR Leaderboard.

Pulse is designed for latency-sensitive voice applications and exposes both HTTP and WebSocket endpoints. Current pay-as-you-go pricing is approximately $0.003/min for pre-recorded Pulse, $0.004/min for realtime Pulse, and $0.0035–$0.004/min for Pulse Pro depending on the current pricing surface. Pulse is not present in the current Open ASR result export, so the catalogue leaves its WER unassigned.
install:
# API endpoint
curl -X POST 'https://api.smallest.ai/waves/v1/stt/?model=pulse&language=en' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMALLEST_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' --data-binary @audio.wav
